description: Ordinary-assertion probes for zero-force Y acceleration fallback and the reported scarf-length cap.

expected_control_cases: GCode mass load acceleration falls back to configured limit without force
GCode mass load acceleration is capped by machine force and bed mass
mutants.expected_failure_case: GCode zero Y force keeps the configured acceleration with printed mass
mutants.description: Remove the positive-force gate. With 100 g bed mass, 100 g printed mass, and 777 configured Y acceleration, the 0 N row must retain 777 while 0.001 N yields the 5 mm/s^2 cap. The shared positive-mass zero-force assertion is the causal detector.

mutants.old: const double slope_min_length         = slope_entire_loop ? loop_length : std::min(m_config.seam_slope_min_length.value, loop_length);
mutants.new: const double slope_min_length         = slope_entire_loop ? loop_length : m_config.seam_slope_min_length.value;
mutants.expected_failure_case: Scarf length and steps have independent geometric witnesses
mutants.description: Remove the caller-side cap for non-entire-loop scarf length. The test measures the active external loop and compares reported scarf distance below, at, and above it; the above-loop distance statistic must stay capped. This is a reported-statistic oracle: the caller value also affects slope subdivision before ExtrusionLoopSloped clamps local geometry, so emitted segmentation is not claimed invariant.
